AntiPattern.WhyBad: `utils.ts` is not a runes file (`AX_RUNES_LOCATION_RESTRICTION`). The Svelte compiler does not process it; `$state` is undefined at runtime and TypeScript reports it as an unknown identifier.
AntiPattern.Good: Rename to `utils.svelte.ts` so the compiler treats it as a runes module: `export const counter = $state(0);` then works. Importers stay unchanged.
